claim: GWAS Catalog association row 23727 lists rs7522462-G at chr1q32.1 as a multiple-sclerosis risk allele with OR 1.11 and p-value 2e-9; the row reports C1orf106 and KIF21B as author genes and the SNP's genomic context includes GPR25 in the local interval.
future_grounding_route: Use as a source-specific intake record for future allele-harmonized chr1 comparison; causal-gene and tractability conclusions still require project-grounded QTL/colocalization and target-direction analysis.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: chr1 KIF21B/GPR25 locus resolves to real biology but hard target

project_use: Sharper external locus record replacing the previous broad GWAS Catalog resource-only row for V50 reassessment.
relationship_note: This record converges on a real MS chr1q32.1 association overlapping the project's KIF21B/GPR25 interval, while preserving causal-gene ambiguity rather than resolving it into an intervention-grade GPR25 or KIF21B target.

source.citation: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog association row for rs7522462 queried through the public REST API.
source.label: GWAS Catalog chr1 rs7522462 MS association row

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: GWAS Catalog public API metadata; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; do not treat API content as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun the GWAS Catalog curation, causal-gene assignment, or chr1 colocalization analysis in the external layer.
